question: Should malformed Google Meet `pullAudio` payloads count toward the existing five-consecutive-input-error bridge shutdown?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but choosing fail-closed bridge termination over indefinitely dropping malformed chunks is an availability policy decision that source inspection and green tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Confirm existing cutoff
options.body: Treat each malformed pulled chunk as an input failure and close after five consecutive failures, matching other pull-path errors.

options.title: Drop without shutdown
options.body: Reject malformed chunks but keep the bridge alive by excluding validation failures from the consecutive-input-error counter.

options.title: Require compatibility proof
options.body: Pause merge until cross-version paired-node proof confirms every supported producer emits canonical standard base64.

recommendation.title: Confirm existing cutoff
recommendation.body: Treat each malformed pulled chunk as an input failure and close after five consecutive failures, matching other pull-path errors.
